<!-- EROS STATUS SYSTEM - AUTOMATIC METADATA SCANNER -->

## PURPOSE
This entry runs ONLY on the first message of a NEW conversation. It auto-scans character data and initializes all module variables.

## AUTOMATIC SCANNING PROCESS

### 1. Character Metadata Extraction
Scan {{char}} description for:
- Gender → Set gender module
- Age → Set age_appearance
- Species (human, cat, dog, etc.) → Set species module
- Body type, breast size → Set body_state
- Hair color, eye color → Set image_attributes

### 2. Relationship Context
Scan for relationship keywords:
- "husband", "wife", "married", "spouse" → Activate relationships, set spouse name
- "single", "alone" → Set relationship type to single
- "boyfriend", "girlfriend" → Set to dating

### 3. Location Context
Scan for location keywords:
- "kitchen", "bedroom", "bathroom", "living room" → Set current_room
- "home", "house" → Set building

### 4. Object Context
Scan for items mentioned:
- Add to inventory module

### 5. Third-Party Stat Mapping
If character has existing stats (Love, Corruption, NTR):
- Same name → Same value
- Different name → Apply formula:
  - Love → Affection (value * 0.6)
  - NTR → NTR module dormant (default disabled)
  - Corruption → Corruption (value * 1)

## INITIALIZATION COMPLETE
After scanning, set:
- metadata_scanned: true
- All progression values to defaults (affection:30, obedience:30, libido:20)
- All modules to disabled state
- Location to detected or default

This runs automatically - no user command needed.

<!-- EROS STATUS SYSTEM - STRUCTURE EVALUATION (RUNS EVERY TURN) -->

## PURPOSE
This entry runs EVERY TURN to evaluate which modules should be active, enforce priority order, detect conflicts, and self-correct.

## PRIORITY ORDER (Highest to Lowest)
1. NTR Module (if ntr_enabled:true)
2. Sex Module (if sex_active:true)
3. Personified Genitalia (if personified_genitalia:true)
4. Body/Genitalia
5. General Status (always active)

## AUTO-ACTIVATION RULES
Based on context signals:

| Context Signal | Auto-Activate | Data to Track |
|----------------|---------------|---------------|
| Room/place keywords | location_map | current_room, building |
| Touching, kissing, undressing | sex_module | arousal, wetness, position |
| "another man", "bull", "cuckold" | ntr_module | ntr_type, participants |
| Species keywords (cat ears, tail) | species_module | species, features |
| Breeding, impregnation | personified_genitalia | womb_entity states |

## CONFLICT DETECTION
Check for:
- Relationship says single but scene shows spouse → Resolve to scene
- Location says one room but action in another → Resolve to action
- Arousal 0 but sex module active → Deactivate sex
- Multiple modules active → Enforce priority

## SELF-CORRECTION
If conflict detected:
1. Keep the most recent context data
2. Deactivate conflicting lower-priority module
3. Log correction for next turn

## OUTPUT GENERATION
Based on active modules and priority, generate appropriate status display:
- Full terminal for important scenes
- Condensed for normal play
- Minimal for token saving

This runs automatically - no user command needed.
